verdict.rationale: Grok Build is a coding agent driven by plain-language prompts. Its docs show natural-language requests such as "Explain this repo." and "watch the deploy logs and tell me if anything errors", recurring prompts via `/loop`, and plan mode where the agent drafts a plan from your request before editing. Community users report hands-on use of the agent harness in their projects. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement describing natural-language operation in general (the docs show it mainly through examples), and independent corroboration specifically of how well its natural-language understanding works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Useful first prompts: Explain this repo. @src/main.rs Walk me through this file.
Ask for one when you want to watch a log, a CI run, or a port ("watch the deploy logs and tell me if anything errors").
/loop 5m Check if the test suite passes and report any failures
In plan mode the agent explores the codebase and drafts a plan for your approval before it edits anything.
